NissanConnect (unofficial)

Self-hosted builds of an unofficial NissanConnect client. Not affiliated with Nissan.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://peter-singh.github.io/nissan-connect-fdroid/fdroid/repo
